conventions.binary: audio bodies are recorded as base64, SHA-256 and byte length; the replay compares those values, never the bytes as text

conventions.stubLimit: the pinned-outbound stub carries UTF-8 payloads only, so the recorded audio bytes are an ASCII pattern; arbitrary binary framing is a stated limitation, not a claimed property

knownDifferences.reason: caption-image is a 250-line per-api provider matrix; the transcribe routes need multipart upload recording (part order and part headers) plus transcription peers; generate-video polls for five seconds per attempt with client-abort semantics. Each needs its own oracle harness, so they are deferred rather than faked.

the Google domain needs OAuth/service-account or api-key provider configuration (getGoogleApiConfig), a static language table imported from google-translate-api-x, PCM-to-WAV wrapping and its own binary capture; it is untouched this round.
